data.summary: Bauspar Beispielheim AG asks Bastian Musterquell to prove that the Bauspardarlehen funds (contract BH 6 330 418-02) will be used for his home, by submitting the heating company's invoice or the signed order, within 10 business days of the letter date (21 November 2026).
data.explanation: Your building-savings bank (Bausparkasse) needs proof that the loan money will go toward your home before it pays out the loan. Send them the heating company's invoice or the signed work order within the deadline shown by the app. If you miss it, the payout is simply pushed back to the first day of the next month — it is not a legal penalty, but delaying it means you get the money later than planned. No action is needed beyond gathering and sending the document.
